from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fit(fun,p0):
    f=lambda p: fun(p)-dP_dt
    s=least_squares(f,p0,max_nfev=5000)
    return np.mean(s.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt), s.x.round(4)
